# Pull request review

- [ ] I selected an existing VSG product or a specific shared portfolio document.
- [ ] This change is within the approved scope; if not, it is clearly labeled a proposal.
- [ ] I did not claim plans, translations, MCP tools, builds or integration tests are implemented without evidence.
- [ ] I checked links, product display name (suffix VSG), WordPress slug stability and language policy where affected.
- [ ] No secrets, customer data, third-party assets without rights, private repo URLs or vulnerability details were included.
- [ ] I described what was actually reviewed or executed (none if documentation-only).
